parole.significato: cooktop, stovetop, hob (base for placing pots or pans on a cooking stove)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Romanian cotlon, itself from Hungarian katlan (“cauldron”), of Slavic origin. Equivalent to котел (kotel) + -он (-on).

parole.significato: a type of percussion instrument (similar to drums)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Romanian tobă, from Hungarian dob (“to drum”), of onomatopoeic origin.
